lines.sub: If you've ever promoted an affiliate product, you know the problem.
Hype. Fake screenshots. Income claims you'd never say out loud.
And when you finally find a good product, there's nothing real to promote it with.
This is the opposite.
ProfitIQS makes business intelligence systems in Excel. Each one built for one industry.
Twenty-one industries. Three editions each. Sixty-three products.
Every one is a ready-built workbook, with dashboards, reports, and a tax set-aside estimate.
The owner enters their numbers. The formulas do the rest.
And sample data means every dashboard works the moment it's opened.
Essential, $97. Elite, $197. Complete, both editions, $249.
One payment. No subscription. It runs in desktop Microsoft Excel.
Here's why owners actually want it.
A plumber can't see which callbacks are eating the margin.
ProfitIQS gives him a Callback Tracker, and a Job Profitability Center.
A restaurant owner doesn't know where prime cost landed.
ProfitIQS gives her a Prime Cost Center, and Menu Intelligence for every dish.
A landlord can't tell which property is dragging the rest down.
ProfitIQS gives him cap rate, cash-on-cash and DSCR, property by property.
A real problem the owner already feels. A real sheet that answers it. Across all twenty-one industries.
And that's exactly what people stop scrolling for.
Four things make it easy to promote, honestly.
One. Every product is built for one industry, so the message fits your audience.
Two. Three price points, so you can recommend the right edition.
Three. A one-time payment. No subscription to explain.
Four. Sample data, so you can screen-record a working dashboard on day one.
Now, the commission.
From the seventeenth of October, twenty twenty-six, to the sixteenth of January, twenty twenty-seven: a ninety percent launch commission.
Then eighty-five percent, from the seventeenth of January to the sixteenth of April.
And from the seventeenth of April, twenty twenty-seven: eighty percent, standard.
Rates are set in Digistore24 at each phase change. The rate set at the time of the sale applies.
As an illustration, at ninety percent, before any fees: an Essential sale is eighty-seven dollars thirty.
Elite, one seventy-seven thirty. Complete, two twenty-four ten.
Fees, taxes, refunds and chargebacks all apply. And no earnings are promised. Not here, and not anywhere in the kit.
How it works is simple.
You share your own Digistore24 affiliate link.
A customer buys through it.
Digistore24 records the sale, and credits your commission on eligible orders.
And you see clicks, sales and refunds in your own dashboard.
And the good news: every product is approved on Digistore24. You can start promoting today.
Now, the part most programs never give you.
A complete kit, for every one of the twenty-one niches.
Every fact in it is labelled: verified from the product files, or general industry context.
Product facts, and real checkout links for all three editions.
A tier comparison, so you recommend the right edition.
Thirty short-form video hooks, and ten full video scripts.
A social calendar, with five carousel decks already designed.
Five email swipes, and an eight-email cold outreach sequence.

Plus an objections guide, and a publishing checklist.
And the Master Kit covers everything shared:
the commission guide, brand messaging, compliance, recruiting copy, a launch checklist, a cold-email playbook, and every checkout link for all sixty-three editions.
Here's your first week.
Pick the niche your audience already lives in.
Read its product facts and tier comparison.
Pick your hooks, scripts and emails, and download the graphics.
Copy your Digistore24 link for the right niche and edition, and test it once in a private window.
Then publish, with a clear disclosure, every time.
And check clicks, sales and refunds weekly. Keep what works.
A few rules keep it all working.
Disclose clearly, next to your link and in your videos.
No fake reviews. No income or results claims.
No spam, and no bidding on the ProfitIQS name in paid search.
No unapproved discounts or bonuses. And no claims of integrations, automation or AI.
Cold email has its own playbook and setup. Your own list gets the swipes.
Quick, honest answers.
Is the ninety percent for life? No. It's the launch rate, then eighty-five, then eighty.
Is it approved on Digistore24? Yes. Every product.
Can you offer a discount? Only if it's on the sales page, or approved in writing.
Who looks after the customer? ProfitIQS handles support. Digistore24 handles orders, payments and refunds.
So here's your next step.
Email support@profitiqs.com, with "Affiliate" in the subject line, and ask for your Affiliate Hub link.
Pick your niche. Open the kit. And promote something you can actually stand behind.
ProfitIQS. Real products. Real kits. Honest promotion.
